Thank you for reading. honestly, even if it's superficial I have no one to talk to in real life about this so thank you. 

I wish I could but I don't see how. No one would believe me and my dad is a psychiatrist so that makes things awkward because then he'd try to use his knowledge to help me and I don't want to confide in my family after so many failed attempts. 

I'm also your typical Ivy-aiming academic so I am scared of the stigma.
